main_text.p: Deorum cultus viritim, gregatimque, discordia ignota, & ægritudo omnis, mors nō nisi fatietate vitæ, epulis, delibutisque fenibus luxu, ex rupe quadam in mare salientibus, hoc genus sepulturæ beatissimum. Quidam eos in prima parte Asiæ littorum posuere, non in Europa, qui sunt ibi similitudine & situs, Attacorum nomine. Alij medios fe-cere eos inter utrumque Solem Antipodum, occasum exorientemque nostrum, quod fieri nullomodo poteft tam vasto mari interveniente. Qui non alibi, quam in seme-stri luce constituere eos, sercere[?] matutinis, meridie metere, occidente sole fœtus arborum decerpere, noctibus in specus condi tradiderunt.
main_text.head: Antistrophe 2.
main_text.p: Herculem Olympia instituisse narrat, quando celebrentur, vbi, qualis is locus fuerit ante Herculis profectionem ad Istriacam terram.
Καὶ μεγάλων.) Superioribus cohærent, explicant πόλιτα ἀπαφυτόμενος[?]: dicuntur Olympica μεγάλα, quod reliquis ludis Græciæ essent celebriora.
Πενταετηρίς.) Tempus annotat, quinto quoque anno celebrari: sed quatuor annis tantum in medio expletis, & initio quinti.

Ἀλλ' ἀ. Qualis fuerit locus iste ante Herculis profectionem ad Hyperboreos, nudus nimirum arboribus, unde & athletæ soli bus torrebantur, & decerat corona victoribus, id deesse huic instituto videbatur Herculi. βάσαγς[?] pro βή-σης Doricū. page.notes: Running head and page number read from the top of the page. Heading "Antistrophe 2." is a small title set apart (level 3); the numeral is uncertain. Greek glosses are partly illegible at this scan resolution: Greek words marked [?] are best readings, and several Greek forms (e.g. "πόλιτα", "βάσαγς", "βάπτης", "βλήμια", "ἀνέμοις") should be checked against the original. "sercere" is uncertain and may be "ferere". The bottom-right mark is a gathering signature. The page ends with a hyphenated word "prae-" continuing on the next page. An ink spot at the right margin near the first lines is not printed text and is omitted.
